comments.comment: A new claim about coherent tunneling appears in Conclusions but was not discussed earlier in the manuscript.
comments.suggestion: Move the tunneling mechanism to Results with supporting analysis, or remove it.
comments.evidence: coherent tunneling of phonons across the silicate layers

comments.comment: The SCF convergence criterion is missing from the Methods description of the electronic structure calculations.
comments.suggestion: State the SCF convergence threshold used for all calculations.

comments.comment: The abstract overclaims the material performance: the headline statement is not supported by the results reported later.
comments.suggestion: Replace the superlative with the computed 1.4 to 1.9 W m-1 K-1 range.
comments.evidence: the lowest thermal conductivity ever reported for any

comments.comment: Section order inversion: the Discussion section appears before Results, so the interpretation precedes the data it refers to.
comments.suggestion: Swap the two sections so Results precedes Discussion.
comments.evidence: The six-atom cluster binds the methoxy intermediate more weakly than the larger clusters

comments.comment: The manuscript has no data availability statement anywhere; deposition of structures and energies is not declared.
comments.suggestion: Add a data availability section naming the repository for coordinates and energies.
comments.evidence: The barrier trend saturates for clusters larger than eight atoms

comments.comment: The SCF convergence threshold is absent from the computational setup; only the cutoff and k-point mesh are given.
comments.suggestion: Report the SCF convergence threshold together with the force tolerance.
